text:
Jordan: Quick sync on Hawk EAP instrumentation — need confirmation on NDA, firmware access for perf counters, and whether power telemetry is possible for daylight runs. Who can take the lead?
Priya: I can own the benchmark playbook. Metrics we need: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, VRAM, and power draw (idle vs peak). Would like a 300-sample prompt set from product for representativeness.
Leo: Firmware team: counters are gated behind a signed NDA + machine serial list. We can provide builds for HAWK-32 and HAWK-64 but behavior differs; will note that in the playbook.
Tess: NDA draft is ready with the limited-distribution clause. Link: https://redwood-internal.share/ndas/hawk-eap (internal). Please keep signers to the EAP list only. I can push for expedited signature if Hawk legal confirms today.
HawkBot: Shared folder created: https://drive.company/hawk-eap — partner uploads enabled, logs folder + perf-results subfolder created. (automated)
Jordan: Good. Hawk legal said they'd expedite if we send the final NDA and a short scope doc. Priya, can you produce a minimal reproducibility checklist (seed, model version, prompt set)?
Priya: On it. Draft checklist: - fixed RNG seed - model: open-redwood-3b@v1.2 - prompt_set_v1.json (300 prompts) - golden_outputs.json for regression checks. Run command I'm testing locally:
```bash
./run_bench --model=open-redwood-3b --batch=4 --seq=2048 --profile=kv --out=results.json
```
Will add instructions to capture perf counters and power.
Leo: Infra notes: use 2x8GB channels, disable SMT, and set CPU/GPU governors to performance. Also ensure firmware build id is recorded in results.json. Power telemetry requires enabling PMU in that firmware; will only be included in builds after NDA.
Jordan: Proposal: weekly feedback loop Tue 10am PT, and a dedicated slack thread for run logs + a shared spreadsheet for runs. Tess, can you confirm NDA recipients and master invite?
Tess: Agreed on cadence. NDA recipients should be: redwood/jordan, redwood/priya, redwood/leo + Hawk legal engineers. Jordan, send the invite and access spreadsheet and I'll blind-cc Hawk legal where needed.
HawkBot: Hawk EAP access granted to redwood/jordan, redwood/priya. (automated)
Jordan: Thanks — I'll finalize NDA edits and post the scope doc. Priya: please aim to post the playbook + prompt set by EOD. Leo: queue the firmware build once NDA signed? :+1:
Priya: On it :rocket:
Leo: Will queue build after NDA is confirmed.
Tess: Sending final NDA in ~10m.
Jordan: Closing loop — next sync Tue 10am PT. I'll drop the calendar invite and spreadsheet now. Thanks everyone!
